identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current SwitchBot shop pages. S20, K10+ Pro, K11+ and K20+ Pro are four separate current models with their own product pages. No new model was created and no company focus was added because SwitchBot is not a source company with a company-authored focus. The reviewed pages publish current shop prices, so the catalog 800, 599, 399 and 700 USD values are replaced by 799.99, 459.99, 399.99 and 699.99 USD. The catalog medium size labels are replaced by reviewed dimensions, and the S20 180 min battery label, the K10+ Pro 150 min battery and runtime labels and the K20+ Pro 150 min battery label are replaced or cleared. The K20+ Pro 8 kg payload is cleared because the reviewed page publishes no payload rating.

It publishes no suction power in Pa, battery capacity in mAh, runtime in minutes or absolute charging time; these remain unrecorded instead of copying figures from the K11+ page.

fields.handType: None; autonomous vacuum and mop robot
fields.description: The SwitchBot S20 is a vacuum and mop robot with 10 kPa (10,000 Pa) suction, a self-rinsing RevoRoll roller mop with about 1 kg downward pressure at 300 scrubs per minute, and carpet auto-boost to 10,000 Pa. Robot dimensions are 365 x 365 x 115 mm, the main unit weighs 5.5 kg and the charging station 5.2 kg. A 4,000 mAh Li-ion battery of six 21700 cells recharges at the station in under 4 hours. Navigation uses dToF LiDAR with an AI camera, front infrared sensor and side PSD. The station provides auto water supply and drainage, mop cleaning during operation, dust emptying every 90 days and hot-air mop drying. Current price is 799.99 USD. No runtime in minutes, payload, travel speed, IP rating or water tank capacity is published; the catalog 800 USD price, medium size label and 180 min battery label are replaced or cleared.

fields.description: The SwitchBot K20+ Pro is a multitasking household robot whose 4,000 Pa suction module sits on a mobile base that weighs 4 kg. Robot dimensions are 248 x 248 x 92 mm and the net weight is 2.3 kg. A 3,500 mAh battery charges in about 4 hours, the robot crosses obstacles up to 20 mm and runs at 80 dB or less, with DTOF laser radar navigation plus app, Alexa and Google Assistant control and Matter support. Current price is 699.99 USD. The reviewed page publishes no runtime in minutes, payload rating, travel speed, IP rating or water tank capacity; the catalog 700 USD price, small size label, 150 min battery label and 8 kg payload are replaced or cleared.

highlights: The SwitchBot K20+ Pro is a multitasking household robot with a 4,000 Pa suction module on a mobile base.
Robot dimensions are 248 x 248 x 92 mm, the net weight is 2.3 kg and the mobile base weighs 4 kg.
A 3,500 mAh battery charges in about 4 hours and the robot crosses obstacles up to 20 mm at 80 dB or less.
